photocraft.name: photo_add_layer
photocraft.description: Add a layer above the active one: pixel, group, solid colour fill or gradient fill. Returns {layer: id}.

photocraft.name: photo_layer_set
photocraft.description: Set layer properties: name, visibility, opacity 0..1, fill 0..1, blend mode, lock, clipping.

photocraft.name: photo_layer_op
photocraft.description: Duplicate, delete, merge down, merge visible or flatten.

photocraft.name: photo_select
photocraft.description: Make a selection: rectangle, ellipse, all, none, invert, subject (AI) or colour range.

photocraft.name: photo_fill
photocraft.description: Fill the selection (or layer) with a colour, or set the foreground/background colours.

control.note: setColors only when foreground/background given; fill only when color or contents given

photocraft.name: photo_adjust
photocraft.description: Apply an adjustment as a new adjustment layer (default) or destructively. kind: brightnessContrast, levels, curves, exposure, vibrance, hueSaturation, colorBalance, blackWhite, photoFilter, channelMixer, invert, posterize, threshold, gradientMap, selectiveColor, colorLookup. params are that adjustment's own (see craft_commands).

destructive.description: image.adjustments.* instead of an adjustment layer

commands: layer.newAdjustmentLayer.<kind> (generated from the ADJ table) → crates/engine/src/commands.rs:1077-1093

photocraft.note: ids are generated at commands.rs:1077-1078 from the ADJ table

photocraft.name: photo_filter
photocraft.description: Run a filter by id suffix, e.g. blur.gaussianBlur {radius:4}. Long filters run as jobs; wait:false returns {job}.

photocraft.name: photo_text
photocraft.description: Add a text layer at a baseline point or in a box.

photocraft.name: photo_mask
photocraft.description: Layer mask: reveal all, hide all, from selection, hide selection, delete, apply.

photocraft.name: photo_canvas
photocraft.description: Image size, canvas size or crop, in pixels.

photocraft.name: photo_jobs
photocraft.description: List background jobs, or cancel one (all when job omitted).

photocraft.name: photo_pixel
photocraft.description: Read the composite colour at x, y.

vectorcraft.name: vector_draw_shape
vectorcraft.description: Draw a live shape with optional paint. rectangle/ellipse: x,y,width,height (radius = corner); polygon: cx,cy,radius,sides; star: cx,cy,radius1,radius2,points; line: x1,y1,x2,y2. Returns {id}.

control.note: paint steps only for given fields; ids = the new object

vectorcraft.name: vector_draw_path
vectorcraft.description: Create a path from points [[x,y],…] (or {x,y,in,out} Béziers) or SVG path data d, with optional paint. Returns {id}.

vectorcraft.name: vector_set_paint
vectorcraft.description: Set fill, stroke and stroke weight on the selection or ids, and as the default for new art.

vectorcraft.name: vector_add_text
vectorcraft.description: Add point type at x,y, area type (width/height), or type in/on a path. Returns {id}.

vectorcraft.name: vector_transform
vectorcraft.description: Move, rotate, scale, reflect or shear the selection or ids; applied in that order. Angles in degrees, scale in %.

vectorcraft.name: vector_pathfinder
vectorcraft.description: Combine selected objects: unite, minusFront, intersect, exclude, divide, trim, merge, crop, outline, minusBack.

vectorcraft.name: vector_effect
vectorcraft.description: Apply a live effect to the selection or ids. Omit effect to get the catalogue.

vectorcraft.name: vector_graph
vectorcraft.description: Create a chart from csv or series/categories/rows in the given rectangle.

vectorcraft.name: vector_text_wrap
vectorcraft.description: Make selected objects wrap area type below them, or release the wrap.

vectorcraft.name: vector_select
vectorcraft.description: Select objects by id (replaces the selection).

vectorcraft.name: vector_arrange
vectorcraft.description: Group, ungroup, lock, hide, bring to front, send to back, or align/distribute the selection.

vectorcraft.name: vector_artboard
vectorcraft.description: Add, resize or delete an artboard (index 0-based).

vectorcraft.name: vector_layer
vectorcraft.description: Add a layer, or change a layer: name, visible, locked.

filmcraft.name: film_sequence
filmcraft.description: The active sequence: tracks, clips (ids, start/duration in ticks), transitions, markers, playhead, selection. 254016000000 ticks = 1 s.

filmcraft.name: film_import
filmcraft.description: Import media files by absolute path (video, audio, images, image sequence).

filmcraft.name: film_frame
filmcraft.description: Look at the sequence frame at a time in seconds (default: playhead). Returns a PNG.

control.note: restore the playhead and selection afterwards (server.rs:417-466); no seconds → screenshot only

filmcraft.name: film_new_sequence
filmcraft.description: Create a sequence: name, width, height, fps, video/audio track counts.

filmcraft.name: film_place
filmcraft.description: Place a project item on the timeline at seconds/frame/ticks, on a track (V1, A1, new).

filmcraft.name: film_cut
filmcraft.description: Split clips at a time (razor): ticks or seconds, optionally one track or clip.

filmcraft.name: film_trim
filmcraft.description: Trim a clip edge by ticks or frames; mode regular or ripple.

filmcraft.name: film_move
filmcraft.description: Move clips: [{clip, track, time}], optionally insert or copy.

filmcraft.name: film_delete
filmcraft.description: Delete clips (ripple closes the gap) or select clips first.

filmcraft.name: film_effect
filmcraft.description: Apply an effect/transition to clips, set a parameter (optionally keyframed), or remove it.

filmcraft.name: film_clip
filmcraft.description: Clip properties: speed %, reverse, audio gain dB, rename, enable.

filmcraft.name: film_playhead
filmcraft.description: Move the playhead (seconds, frame, timecode or ticks).

filmcraft.name: film_track
filmcraft.description: Track state: lock, mute, solo, enable, name, volume dB, pan; or add tracks.

filmcraft.name: film_export
filmcraft.description: Export media (h264, hevc, prores, png, wav…) to a path. Long: runs as a job and is polled until it finishes.
filmcraft.note: poll jobs.list via engine.execute until finished (bridge.rs:41-70); the control server answers within 60 s

lightcraft.name: light_import
lightcraft.description: Add photos or folders to the library. mode add (in place), copy or move; optional album, organize, rename template.

params.paths: $paths expanded to files (folders scanned recursively, client-side)

lightcraft.name: light_photos
lightcraft.description: List photos (id, name, rating, flag, edited…). No filter: the current view.

lightcraft.name: light_select
lightcraft.description: Select photos by id; the active one is what develop tools edit.

lightcraft.name: light_controls
lightcraft.description: List develop sliders: id (light.exposure), range, default, current value.

lightcraft.name: light_develop_get
lightcraft.description: All develop settings of a photo as JSON.

lightcraft.name: light_develop
lightcraft.description: Edit a photo: values sets sliders by control id ({"light.exposure":0.7}); settings deep-merges develop JSON.

control.note: then echoes the touched sliders (tools.rs set_develop)

lightcraft.name: light_auto
lightcraft.description: Auto-adjust the active photo (tone and colour).

lightcraft.name: light_preset
lightcraft.description: Apply a develop preset to the selection or ids at amount 0..200 %.

lightcraft.name: light_crop
lightcraft.description: Crop with rect [x0,y0,x1,y1] (0..1) and/or angle; reset:true clears it.

lightcraft.name: light_rate
lightcraft.description: Rate 0-5, flag pick/reject/none, or colour label for the selection or ids.

lightcraft.name: light_meta
lightcraft.description: Set title, caption, copyright, creator, location and keywords (keywords/addKeywords/removeKeywords).

lightcraft.name: light_album
lightcraft.description: Create an album (optionally with the selection), or add/remove photos.

lightcraft.name: light_filter
lightcraft.description: Filter the library view (rating, flag, label, text, kind, edited, date…) and sort it.

lightcraft.name: light_copy_settings
lightcraft.description: Copy the active photo's develop settings, paste them on the selection, or sync them.

lightcraft.name: light_export
lightcraft.description: Export photos to a path or folder: format, size (longEdge…), quality, naming, watermark.

lightcraft.name: light_render
lightcraft.description: Render a photo with its edits (PNG/JPEG), long edge size px, default 1024.
lightcraft.note: id defaults to library.state selection.active; reads the temp file, re-encodes, optionally copies to path (tools.rs:495-515)

pdfcraft.name: pdf_view
pdfcraft.description: View options: zoom %, layout (continuous|single|two-up), rotate (0/90/180/270), panel (comments|bookmarks|pages|fields|layers|search|…), mode (read|edit|convert|sign).

pdfcraft.name: pdf_find
pdfcraft.description: Search the open document; hits are highlighted and listed in the Search panel.

pdfcraft.name: pdf_pages
pdfcraft.description: Select pages (1-based) in the page grid, then rotate, delete, duplicate, extract or insert blank with pdf_page.

pdfcraft.name: pdf_page
pdfcraft.description: Act on the selected pages like the Pages menu: rotate, rotate_ccw, delete, duplicate, insert_blank, extract, number, crop. Dialog commands open a dialog.
pdfcraft.note: takes no params; result is {ran}; verify with pdf_state; live check needed for which actions open a dialog

pdfcraft.name: pdf_tool
pdfcraft.description: Pick the active tool before drawing with craft_run ui.drag: select, hand, note, freetext, highlight, underline, strikeout, ink, line, arrow, square, circle, redact, add-text, link, stamp-<name>, field-<kind>, fill-<kind>.

pdfcraft.name: pdf_comment_select
pdfcraft.description: Select the Nth annotation on a page (as listed in the Comments panel).

pdfcraft.name: pdf_file_info
pdfcraft.description: Info for a PDF file on disk: pages, size, metadata. Does not read the open document.

pdfcraft.name: pdf_file_text
pdfcraft.description: Extract text from a PDF file on disk, optionally one page.

pdfcraft.name: pdf_file_edit
pdfcraft.description: Write a changed copy of a PDF: rotate, delete, move or insert blank pages, set title/author. Never overwrites the input.

pdfcraft.name: pdf_file_extract
pdfcraft.description: Copy chosen pages (1-based list) into a new PDF.

pdfcraft.name: pdf_file_split
pdfcraft.description: Split a PDF every N pages or before given pages.

effectcraft.name: effect_comp
effectcraft.description: A composition: size, frame rate, duration, work area, and its layers top to bottom (ids, in/out, blend, parent, matte).

effectcraft.name: effect_layer
effectcraft.description: A layer's property tree with paths usable by effect_get/effect_set; flat:true for a compact list.

effectcraft.name: effect_get
effectcraft.description: Read one property: value at time, keyframes, expression.

effectcraft.name: effect_set
effectcraft.description: Set a property value; with time it keyframes; expression sets an expression ("" removes).

effectcraft.name: effect_keys
effectcraft.description: Add keyframes ([{time, value}]) to a property and set interpolation: linear, bezier, hold, easyEase, easyEaseIn, easyEaseOut.

effectcraft.name: effect_new_comp
effectcraft.description: Create a composition: name, width, height, frameRate, duration (s), background.

effectcraft.name: effect_add_layer
effectcraft.description: Add a layer: text, solid, shape, null, adjustment, camera or light. Returns {layer: id}.

effectcraft.name: effect_add_effect
effectcraft.description: Apply an effect to a layer and set its parameters in one undo step. Returns the instance path (effects/#n).

effectcraft.name: effect_list_effects
effectcraft.description: The effect registry: id, name, category.

effectcraft.name: effect_fonts
effectcraft.description: Font families text layers can use.

effectcraft.name: effect_frame
effectcraft.description: Render a composition frame at a time (s) as PNG, long side max_side (default 960).
effectcraft.note: control METHOD, not an engine command (adapter has it viaEngine: see report)

effectcraft.name: effect_script
effectcraft.description: Run JavaScript with an After Effects-style object model (app.project, comp.layers.addText, property().setValueAtTime…). Each edit is undoable.

effectcraft.name: effect_batch
effectcraft.description: Run commands as ONE undo step; "$N" / "$N.key" in a param is step N's result (1-based); rolls back if a step fails.

designcraft.name: design_new
designcraft.description: New document: preset (Letter, A4, Tabloid) or width/height pt, pages, facing pages, columns, margins, bleed; or the sample magazine.

designcraft.name: design_frame
designcraft.description: Create a frame (text, graphic or empty; rectangle, ellipse, polygon) at rect [x0,y0,x1,y1] in spread points, optionally with text. Returns {id, story}.

designcraft.name: design_story
designcraft.description: Full text of a story with length, frames, paragraphs, overset position. Identify by story or frame id (default: selection).

designcraft.name: design_set_story
designcraft.description: Replace a story's whole text (\n = new paragraph).

designcraft.name: design_place_image
designcraft.description: Place an image (path) into a frame, or a new frame at x,y with width.

designcraft.name: design_style
designcraft.description: Apply or create a paragraph style.

designcraft.name: design_paint
designcraft.description: Fill and/or stroke the selection or ids with a swatch; create a swatch from a colour first.

designcraft.name: design_move
designcraft.description: Move the selection or ids by dx, dy points; copy:true duplicates.

designcraft.name: design_pages
designcraft.description: Insert, delete or move pages (page indices 0-based).

designcraft.name: design_layer
designcraft.description: Add or change a layer: name, visible, locked, printable.

designcraft.name: design_render_page
designcraft.description: Render a page (0-based, default current) as PNG without bleed; scale px per pt.
designcraft.note: reply holds pngBase64; path is written by the host (tools.rs:476-485)

designcraft.name: design_export
designcraft.description: Export to PDF, EPUB, HTML, text or IDML.

soundcraft.name: sound_import
soundcraft.description: Import audio (WAV, AIFF, FLAC, MP3, OGG, M4A) onto new tracks or a given track at a position.

soundcraft.name: sound_bounce
soundcraft.description: Render the mix to an audio file; returns peak dBFS and integrated LUFS.

soundcraft.name: sound_add_track
soundcraft.description: Add tracks: count, kind (audio, aux, master, midi, instrument, vca, folder), format (mono, stereo, 5.1), name.

soundcraft.name: sound_track
soundcraft.description: Rename, delete, duplicate or colour tracks (id or name).

soundcraft.name: sound_select
soundcraft.description: Select a time range on tracks (start/end: sample count, {"seconds": x} or "bars_beats:5|1|000" / "0:12.500") or clips by id.

soundcraft.name: sound_edit
soundcraft.description: Edit the selection: cut, copy, paste (at), duplicate, separate (split at), trim_to_selection, delete.

soundcraft.name: sound_move_clips
soundcraft.description: Move clips by samples, to a position, or onto another track.

soundcraft.name: sound_clip
soundcraft.description: Clip gain dB (db or delta_db), rename, colour, loop count, fades via clip effects.

soundcraft.name: sound_mix
soundcraft.description: Mixer state for tracks: volume dB, pan -1..1, mute, solo, record arm.

soundcraft.name: sound_insert
soundcraft.description: Put a plug-in on a track insert slot (0-9 or a-j), set its parameters, bypass or remove it.

soundcraft.name: sound_send
soundcraft.description: Route a track to a bus: send level dB, pre-fader.

soundcraft.name: sound_automation
soundcraft.description: Write automation: a point (at, value) or a range (start, end, value); param volume, pan, mute, send_a_level, plugin:a:<id>. clear:true removes.

soundcraft.name: sound_transport
soundcraft.description: Play (from position), stop, record, return to zero.

soundcraft.name: sound_tempo
soundcraft.description: Set tempo (bpm at a position), meter, or add a marker.

soundcraft.name: sound_midi
soundcraft.description: Add a MIDI note to a clip (pitch, start_ticks, length_ticks, velocity), transpose or quantize clips.

deckcraft.name: deck_new
deckcraft.description: New presentation (one title slide). Themes: DeckCraft, Harbor, Ember, Meadow, Nocturne, Paper, Coral Reef, Slate.

deckcraft.name: deck_slide
deckcraft.description: One slide's shapes (ids, kinds, boxes [x,y,w,h], text, fills), background, transition, animations, notes. Default: current slide.

deckcraft.name: deck_render_slide
deckcraft.description: Render a slide to PNG to check it (default: current).

deckcraft.name: deck_add_slide
deckcraft.description: Add a slide after the current one: layout (title, titleAndContent, sectionHeader, twoContent, comparison, titleOnly, blank…), title, body (one paragraph per line, leading tabs indent).

deckcraft.name: deck_go
deckcraft.description: Make a slide current (shape tools act on it).

deckcraft.name: deck_slide_op
deckcraft.description: Duplicate, delete, move, hide, rename, set layout or speaker notes of a slide.

deckcraft.name: deck_add_shape
deckcraft.description: Insert a preset shape (rect, roundRect, ellipse, triangle, rightArrow, chevron, star5, heart, cloud, line…) at x,y,w,h with optional text, fill and outline colour. Returns {id}.

deckcraft.name: deck_add_text
deckcraft.description: Insert a text box at x,y, width w; text one paragraph per line; size, colour, align.

deckcraft.name: deck_set_text
deckcraft.description: Replace a shape's text (leading tabs set bullet levels).

deckcraft.name: deck_add_picture
deckcraft.description: Insert a picture from a path, optionally at x,y,w,h.

deckcraft.name: deck_add_table
deckcraft.description: Insert a table rows×cols with optional cell text (data: rows of strings).

deckcraft.name: deck_add_chart
deckcraft.description: Insert a chart: type (column, bar, line, pie, doughnut, area, scatter, stackedColumn), title, categories, series [{name, values}].

deckcraft.name: deck_format
deckcraft.description: Format the selected shapes or ids: bold, size, colour, align, fill, outline.

deckcraft.name: deck_arrange
deckcraft.description: Align, distribute, group, ungroup, reorder or nudge shapes.

deckcraft.name: deck_design
deckcraft.description: Apply a theme, set the slide background, or add a transition/animation.

cadcraft.name: cad_command_line
cadcraft.description: Type one line at the command prompt like a user: line 0,0 @10,0 @0,5 c; circle 5,2 1; offset 0.5; zoom e. Spaces act as Enter. Returns the new prompt and output; check error.

cadcraft.name: cad_script
cadcraft.description: Run several command-line inputs, one per line (blank line = Enter).

cadcraft.name: cad_line
cadcraft.description: Draw a line or open polyline through points [[x,y],…].

cadcraft.name: cad_polyline
cadcraft.description: Draw a polyline with vertices [[x,y]] or {p, bulge, startWidth, endWidth}; closed, width.

cadcraft.name: cad_circle
cadcraft.description: Draw a circle: center+radius, center+diameter, 2 points or 3 points.

cadcraft.name: cad_arc
cadcraft.description: Draw an arc: 3 points, or center+radius+start+end (degrees).

cadcraft.name: cad_rect
cadcraft.description: Draw a rectangle from two corners, or dimensions [l, w]; optional rotation, fillet, chamfer.

cadcraft.name: cad_text
cadcraft.description: Add text at a point: height, rotation, justify; mtext for wrapped text (width).

cadcraft.name: cad_dimension
cadcraft.description: Add a linear or aligned dimension between p1 and p2, with the line placed at `at`.

cadcraft.name: cad_modify
cadcraft.description: Change entities by handle: move, copy, rotate, erase (handles default to the selection).

cadcraft.name: cad_layer
cadcraft.description: Create a layer (name, colour, linetype, current), make one current, or change on/frozen/locked.

cadcraft.name: cad_hatch
cadcraft.description: Hatch closed objects (handles) or an area around internal points: pattern, scale, angle.

cadcraft.name: cad_zoom
cadcraft.description: Zoom: extents, all, window (p1,p2), in, out, previous, scale (factor).

cadcraft.name: cad_query
cadcraft.description: Entities filtered by type, layer or window [[x0,y0],[x1,y1]]; page with offset and limit.

cadcraft.name: cad_render
cadcraft.description: Render the drawing to a PNG (fit to extents by default).

cadcraft.name: cad_cancel
cadcraft.description: Press Escape: cancel the running command or clear the selection.

wordcraft.name: word_new
wordcraft.description: New document: blank, sample, letter, resume or report.

wordcraft.name: word_type
wordcraft.description: Type at the caret (replaces the selection). paragraphs:true turns each line into a paragraph.

control.note: one text.insert per line when paragraphs:true

wordcraft.name: word_select
wordcraft.description: Select the n-th occurrence of some text (1-based).

wordcraft.name: word_text
wordcraft.description: Plain text of the document body.

wordcraft.name: word_format
wordcraft.description: Format the selection: bold, italic, underline, font, size, colour (RRGGBB), highlight.

wordcraft.name: word_paragraph
wordcraft.description: Paragraph style (Heading 1, Normal…), alignment, line spacing, spacing before/after, indents, bullets or numbering.

wordcraft.name: word_insert
wordcraft.description: Insert a table (rows, cols), link (url, text), picture (path), page break, header/footer text, shape, symbol.

wordcraft.name: word_replace
wordcraft.description: Find and replace text; all:true replaces every match; matchCase, wholeWord, regex.

wordcraft.name: word_table
wordcraft.description: Edit the table at the caret: insert/delete row or column, merge or split cells, style.

wordcraft.name: word_review
wordcraft.description: Track changes on/off, add or reply to a comment, accept or reject all changes, word count.

wordcraft.name: word_render_page
wordcraft.description: Render a page (1-based) to PNG; scale px per pt.

gridcraft.name: grid_read_range
gridcraft.description: Read cell values as rows. No range reads the used range.

range.description: A1-style range, e.g. A1:D10, B:B, Sheet2!A1:C3

gridcraft.name: grid_write_range
gridcraft.description: Write rows of values from the top-left cell. Strings starting with = are formulas.

range.description: top-left cell, e.g. A1 or Sheet2!B3

gridcraft.name: grid_set_cell
gridcraft.description: Enter one cell as typed: number, text or =formula.

gridcraft.name: grid_get_cell
gridcraft.description: One cell: value, formula, display text, style, comment.

gridcraft.name: grid_eval
gridcraft.description: Evaluate a formula without changing any cell.

cell.description: evaluate as if in this cell

gridcraft.name: grid_format_range
gridcraft.description: Format a range: bold, italic, underline, font, colours (#RRGGBB), number format, alignment, wrap, borders preset.

range.description: A1-style range, e.g. A1:D10, B:B, Sheet2!A1:C3

borders.description: preset: all, outside, bottom, top, none…

control.note: one engine.execute per given property, each with range; first failure stops and lists what was applied

gridcraft.name: grid_insert_chart
gridcraft.description: Insert a chart from a range with headers (column, bar, line, pie, area, scatter, combo, histogram…).

gridcraft.name: grid_create_table
gridcraft.description: Format a range as a table with filter buttons.

gridcraft.name: grid_sort
gridcraft.description: Sort a range by columns, e.g. keys ["B"] or [{"column":"B","order":"desc"}].

gridcraft.name: grid_filter
gridcraft.description: Filter rows by a column: values, custom {op,value}, top {count}, or clear.

gridcraft.name: grid_sheet
gridcraft.description: Add, rename, delete, activate or move a worksheet.

gridcraft.name: grid_conditional_format
gridcraft.description: Add a conditional-format rule: cellIs, containsText, duplicate, top10, colorScale, dataBar, iconSet…

rule.description: {type, operator?, value?, formula?, text?, colors?, preset?: lightRedFill|redText|yellowFill|greenFill…}

gridcraft.name: grid_pivot
gridcraft.description: Create a pivot table from a range or table; rows/columns/values/filters take field names.

source.description: range or table name; default: current region

gridcraft.name: grid_validation
gridcraft.description: Set data validation: type list|whole|decimal|date|textLength|custom, operator, formula1/2; clear:true removes it.

formula1.description: for list: comma-separated items or a range
